1.t: Nay, I swear by this city -

2.t: And thou art an indweller of this city -

3.t: And the begetter and that which he begat,

4.t: We verily have created man in an atmosphere:

5.t: Thinketh he that none hath power over him?

6.t: And he saith: I have destroyed vast wealth:

7.t: Thinketh he that none beholdeth him?

8.t: Did We not assign unto him two eyes

9.t: And a tongue and two lips,

10.t: And guide him to the parting of the mountain ways?

11.t: But he hath not attempted the Ascent -

12.t: Ah, what will convey unto thee what the Ascent is! -

14.t: And to feed in the day of hunger.

16.t: Or some poor wretch in misery,

17.t: And to be of those who believe and exhort one another to perseverance and exhort one another to pity.

18.t: Their place will be on the right hand.

19.t: But those who disbelieve Our revelations, their place will be on the left hand.

20.t: Fire will be an awning over them.
